_comment: Bare calls to monkeypatched symbols, per module. See scripts/bare_call_ratchet.py.
These are the Route A conversion targets from docs/design/2026-08-19-split-floor-escape.md.
Each number may only go DOWN, and every decrease must be banked here in the same commit --
the ratchet fails on a pin left above the real count, because a pin above the count accepts
a range, and a range is where a later regression hides.
